title: Renewed US–Iran hostilities disrupt Gulf airspace
summary: Following the onset of hostilities between the United States and Iran on 28 February 2026, the region saw drone and missile threats and significant disruptions to commercial flights; the U.S. ordered the departure of non-emergency government staff from Qatar on 2 March.
airline_response: Qatar Airways routed all Doha traffic through a limited set of QCAA-authorised corridors and progressively restored its schedule as airspace reopened; by mid-2026 Doha operations were reported to be close to normal.

sources.label: U.S. State Dept — Qatar Travel Advisory
